title: Office Interior Designer in Gurgaon: What to Expect from Design to Handover
author: Shivam Kumar

featuredImage.alt: Office interior designer in Gurgaon reviewing a workspace layout with a client

excerpt: An office interior designer in Gurgaon plans, prices and (on a turnkey contract) builds your office. See the 7 stages from brief to handover, realistic timelines, costs by tier, and what to check before you hire.
keyTakeaways: Seven Stages, Clear Deliverables — Brief and survey, space planning, concept and costing, drawings and approvals, procurement, site execution, then testing and handover.
Timelines Scale with Size — 8 to 14 weeks for 1,000–3,000 sq ft; 12 to 20 weeks for 5,000–10,000 sq ft, including 2 to 4 weeks of design and approvals.
Budget by Tier, Not a Single Number — ₹1,200–₹1,800 per sq ft basic, ₹1,800–₹2,800 mid-range, ₹2,800–₹4,500 premium, ₹4,500–₹7,000+ CXO-grade, all before GST.
Hire Before the Lease Is Signed — Rent-free fit-out periods run 30 to 90 days; starting design only after signing eats into that window.
Bare Shell vs Warm Shell Swings the Budget — The same design can differ by ₹600–₹1,200 per sq ft purely on handover condition.
Plan 80 to 110 Sq Ft per Seat — Dense operations floors need 50 to 70 sq ft; cabin-heavy leadership floors need 120 to 150 sq ft.
contentHtml:
An office interior designer in Gurgaon plans your floor, designs it, prices it and, on a turnkey contract, builds it. Expect seven stages from brief to handover. A 1,000 to 3,000 sq ft office takes about 8 to 14 weeks in total and a 5,000 to 10,000 sq ft floor about 12 to 20 weeks. Budgets typically run ₹1,200 to ₹7,000+ per sq ft before GST.

Most companies fit out an office once every few years, so the process is unfamiliar each time. You sign a lease, the rent clock starts, and several decisions have to be made in the right order. This guide explains what an office interior designer in Gurgaon does, stage by stage, and what you should have in hand at each point.

Key facts at a glance

QuestionShort answer
How long does an office fit-out take in Gurgaon?8 to 14 weeks up to 3,000 sq ft; 12 to 20 weeks for 5,000 to 10,000 sq ft, including design
What does it cost?₹1,200 to ₹7,000+ per sq ft before GST, by specification tier
What is the corporate benchmark?About ₹6,207 per sq ft for a collaborative hybrid workplace in Delhi (Cushman & Wakefield, 2026)
How much space per person?80 to 110 sq ft per seat for a standard corporate office, including shared areas
What condition are offices handed over in?Bare shell or warm shell in most Grade A buildings
How long is the rent-free fit-out period?Commonly 30 to 90 days, negotiated in the lease
When should the designer be hired?Before the lease is signed

What does an office interior designer in Gurgaon do?

An office interior designer turns a headcount and a floor plate into a working office. The scope covers space planning, the look and feel, lighting, furniture, and the drawings that electrical, air-conditioning, fire and data contractors build from.

There are two ways to hire one:

  • Design only. You receive drawings and specifications, then appoint and manage contractors yourself.
  • Design and build, or turnkey. One firm designs, procures and executes, and is accountable for cost, quality and the handover date.

Most small and mid-sized companies choose turnkey, because an office involves more trades than a home and the cost of a late move-in is rent. Our guide to the roles of a designer, architect and contractor explains the difference in more detail.

The 7 stages from design to handover

StageWhat happensWhat you receive
1. Brief and site surveyHeadcount, work style, budget and move-in date are recorded. The floor is measured and existing services are checked.Written brief; measured drawing
2. Space planningSeats, cabins, meeting rooms, reception and pantry are arranged on the floor plate. This is often called a test fit.Layout with seat count
3. Concept, 3D and costingMaterials, lighting and furniture are chosen. Every item is priced.3D views; material board; itemised BOQ
4. Drawings and approvalsWorking drawings are prepared for partitions, ceiling, electrical, HVAC and fire services, and submitted to building management.Construction drawings; building approval
5. ProcurementLong-lead items are ordered: glass, custom joinery, HVAC equipment and workstations.Order schedule with delivery dates
6. Site executionPartitions, first-fix services, ceiling and flooring, second-fix services, then furniture.Weekly progress reports
7. Testing and handoverSystems are commissioned, the fire alarm is tested and snags are closed.Handover file

Stages 1 to 4 usually take 2 to 4 weeks together. Procurement starts the day the design is frozen and runs alongside the early site work. Stage 7 takes the final 1 to 2 weeks.

Where projects go wrong

Rarely on site. The common causes of delay are an unclear brief, late feedback from the building, an incomplete survey of existing services and long lead times on imported material. All four belong to stages 1 to 5, which is why a layout frozen on paper matters more than speed on site.

How long does an office interior project take in Gurgaon?

Office sizeDesign and approvalsSite executionTotal
1,000 to 3,000 sq ft2 to 4 weeks6 to 10 weeks8 to 14 weeks
5,000 to 10,000 sq ft2 to 4 weeks10 to 16 weeks12 to 20 weeks
Multi-floor or phasedPlanned floor by floorPhased by zoneCan run 20 weeks or more

Timelines stretch with HVAC scope, the number of enclosed rooms, building approval cycles and restrictions on working hours.

The rent-free gap. Rent-free fit-out periods in Gurgaon leases are commonly 30 to 90 days. Even a small office takes 8 weeks, which is 56 days. If design only begins after the lease is signed, part of the fit-out will run on paid rent. Bring the designer in while you are still comparing spaces.

What your designer needs from you

A good brief shortens every later stage. Have these ready for the first meeting:

  1. Headcount today and in 24 to 36 months.
  2. Work pattern: fully in office or hybrid, and the desk-sharing ratio if any.
  3. Room list: cabins, meeting rooms by size, phone booths, server room, pantry.
  4. Lease documents and the building's fit-out guidelines.
  5. Handover condition: bare shell or warm shell, and what the landlord provides.
  6. IT and AV needs: video-conferencing rooms, access control, data points per seat.
  7. Brand guidelines, budget ceiling and move-in date.

On space, a standard corporate office works out to about 80 to 110 sq ft per seat once reception, meeting rooms, pantry and circulation are included. Dense operations floors run 50 to 70 sq ft, and cabin-heavy leadership floors 120 to 150 sq ft.

Five things specific to Gurgaon offices

1. Bare shell or warm shell

A bare shell is a concrete floor with no ceiling, flooring or internal air-conditioning distribution. A warm shell adds basic HVAC and lighting. Many Grade A towers in Cyber City and on Golf Course Extension Road hand over bare shell, and the same design can differ by ₹600 to ₹1,200 per sq ft on handover condition alone.

2. Building management approval

Occupied towers usually require fit-out drawings to be approved before work starts and may ask for a refundable fit-out deposit. Get the building's guidelines at the lease stage and build the approval cycle into the programme.

3. Working-hour restrictions

Noisy work is often limited to nights and weekends in occupied buildings. That affects both the schedule and the labour cost, so it should be priced, not discovered.

4. Fire and HVAC changes

New partitions change sprinkler coverage, detector positions and air distribution. Fire safety in Haryana falls under the Haryana Fire and Emergency Services Act, 2022, and any change has to stay within the building's approved fire scheme. Building management will tell you what they need to see.

5. Reinstatement at exit

Many leases require the space to be returned to bare or warm shell. Know the clause before you design, since it affects what is worth building in.

What does office interior design cost in Gurgaon?

Gurgaon fit-out benchmarks for 2026 fall into three tiers, before GST:

TierCost per sq ftSuited to
Basic / Functional₹1,200 to ₹1,800Startups, back offices, small teams
Mid-range corporate₹1,800 to ₹2,800Growing SMEs, regional offices
Premium₹2,800 to ₹4,500MNC branches, consulting and finance firms
Luxury / CXO₹4,500 to ₹7,000+Headquarters, family offices, CXO floors

For comparison, Cushman & Wakefield's India Office Fit-Out Cost Guide 2026 puts a collaborative hybrid workplace in Delhi at about ₹6,207 per sq ft, against ₹6,567 in Mumbai and ₹6,027 in Bengaluru. That figure reflects large corporate specifications.

Per-seat maths, the cost breakdown by trade and the charges most quotes leave out are in our office interior design cost guide for Gurgaon.

How to shortlist an office interior designer in Gurgaon

CheckWhat good looks like
Relevant workA completed office you can visit, not only 3D renders
AccountabilityOne contract for design and execution, with a named project lead
CostingAn itemised BOQ with brands and quantities, and a written list of exclusions
Services capabilityHVAC, electrical, fire and data handled in-house or by named partners
ProgrammeA week-by-week schedule with milestones and a long-lead list
Building experienceFamiliarity with fit-out approvals in occupied towers
PaymentsTied to milestones, not to dates
After handoverWarranty and defect terms in writing

Ask every firm for the same scope so the numbers can be compared. Our guide on how to compare interior design quotations shows the method.

Handover: what you should receive

Handover is a set of documents as well as a set of keys. Ask for:

  • A signed snag list with every item closed.
  • As-built drawings for layout, electrical, HVAC, fire and data.
  • Test and commissioning records for electrical and fire alarm systems.
  • Operation and maintenance manuals for installed equipment.
  • Warranty cards for furniture, hardware, lighting and equipment.
  • The building's sign-off, where one is required.
  • Written terms for defects found after you move in.

faqs.question: What does an office interior designer do?
faqs.answer: An office interior designer plans how people, rooms and services fit on a floor, then designs the finishes, lighting and furniture and prepares drawings for construction. On a turnkey contract the same firm also procures materials and executes the work through to handover.

faqs.question: How long does an office interior project take in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: About 8 to 14 weeks in total for a 1,000 to 3,000 sq ft office and 12 to 20 weeks for a 5,000 to 10,000 sq ft floor. That includes 2 to 4 weeks for design and approvals before site work begins.

faqs.question: How much does office interior design cost in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: Typically ₹1,200 to ₹1,800 per sq ft for a basic office, ₹1,800 to ₹2,800 for mid-range, ₹2,800 to ₹4,500 for premium and ₹4,500 to ₹7,000 or more for CXO-grade offices, before GST. Handover condition, HVAC scope and the number of enclosed rooms move the figure most.

faqs.question: When should I hire an office interior designer, before or after signing the lease?
faqs.answer: Before. A designer can test whether your headcount fits the floor, estimate the fit-out cost for a bare or warm shell, and start design early so that work begins as soon as the rent-free period does.

faqs.question: Do I need the landlord's approval for office interiors?
faqs.answer: In most Grade A buildings in Gurgaon, yes. Building management usually approves fit-out drawings before work starts, may ask for a refundable deposit and often restricts noisy work to nights and weekends.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a bare shell and a warm shell office?
faqs.answer: A bare shell office is a concrete floor without ceiling, flooring or internal air-conditioning distribution. A warm shell includes basic HVAC and lighting. A bare shell needs more work and a larger budget for the same design.

faqs.question: How much office space do I need per employee?
faqs.answer: Plan about 80 to 110 sq ft per seat for a standard corporate office, counting shared areas such as reception, meeting rooms and pantry. Dense layouts use 50 to 70 sq ft per seat and cabin-heavy floors 120 to 150 sq ft.

faqs.question: What should I receive at handover?
faqs.answer: A closed snag list, as-built drawings, electrical and fire alarm test records, operation and maintenance manuals, warranty cards and written terms for defects found after move-in.
